title: smtp: wire-level integration tests
description: Write crates/smtp/tests/smtp_tests.rs. Start server on ephemeral port in-process (same pattern as mail crate's jmap_e2e.rs). Use tokio::net::TcpStream + BufReader to simulate a mail client. Tests: (1) greeting: connect, read 220 banner; (2) EHLO: send EHLO test, verify 250 multi-line with SIZE/8BITMIME/SMTPUTF8; (3) full MAIL+RCPT+DATA: send EHLO, MAIL FROM:<from@test.com>, RCPT TO:<to@test.com>, DATA, message body ending with CRLF.CRLF, verify 250 accepted; check MessageQueue receiver got IncomingMessage with correct envelope_from, envelope_to, raw_bytes; (4) RSET clears state: MAIL FROM, RSET, verify next MAIL FROM succeeds; (5) QUIT: send QUIT, verify 221; (6) unknown command: send XYZZY, verify 500. Each test creates its own server+queue pair on a random port.
